description: An airport can either install escalators or elevators. Escalators can transport 20 people every minute whereas elevators can transport 8 people every minute. Escalators take up 5 units of space while elevators take 2 units of space. The airport needs to have enough capacity to transport at least 400 people every minute. Additionally, there must be at least three times more escalators than elevators and at least 2 elevators must be used. How many of each type should the airport install to minimize the total units of space taken?

TransportRateEscalator.definition: Transport rate of an escalator in people per minute

TransportRateElevator.definition: Transport rate of an elevator in people per minute

SpaceEscalator.definition: Space taken by an escalator in units

SpaceElevator.definition: Space taken by an elevator in units

MinPeopleTransport.definition: Minimum number of people to transport per minute

RatioEscalatorsToElevators.definition: Minimum ratio of escalators to elevators

MinElevators.definition: Minimum number of elevators to be installed

objective.description: "Minimize the total units of space taken by the installed escalators and elevators"

constraints.description: Number of escalators and number of elevators must be integers

numberEscalators.definition: Number of escalators to be installed at the airport

numberElevators.definition: Number of elevators to be installed at the airport
